'''Cooper's''' was an establishment on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The name was printed in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on a blue sign.<ref name="Invasion" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cooper's first appeared in [[Invasion 5|''Invasion'' 5]], published on [[November 4]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/15-947/Star-Wars-Invasion-5|text=Star Wars: Invasion #5}}</ref> Per {{U|CooperTFN}}'s recollection, the bar was named after himself by writer [[Tom Taylor]] and illustrator [[Colin Wilson (artist)|Colin Wilson]],<ref name="Cooper">{{WookCite|url=User:CooperTFN?type=revision&diff=10217979&oldid=10212693|text=April 2, 2021 revision of "CooperTFN" userpage}}</ref> following an interview with Taylor published by Cooper on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] on [[February 19]], [[2009]].<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=threads/29799900|board=Star Wars Books, Comics, and Expanded Universe|thread=My Interview with Star Wars: Invasion's Tom Taylor!!! (Bonus: Mac's interview with Colin Wilson!!!)|user={{U|CooperTFN}}|date=2009-02-19|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220422175805/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/my-interview-with-star-wars-invasions-tom-taylor-bonus-macs-interview-with-colin-wilson.29799900|archivedate=20220422175805}}</ref>
